settings.accountDescription: Your personal profile. These details are visible to other members of your organizations.
settings.analyticsDescription: See what your agents cost, how often they run, and how reliably they finish.
settings.apiKeysDescription: Manage API keys used to authenticate requests.
settings.auditLogDescription: Review changes made across your organization.
settings.billingDescription: Track how much of your plan you have used.
settings.billingPlanDescription: Your plan, its limits, and payment details.
settings.channelsDescription: Chat platforms connected to this project. Each connection answers as one agent.
settings.creditsDescription: What your organization has left, where it went, and how to add more.
settings.integrationsDescription: Connect the integrations your agents can use.
settings.llmsDescription: Connect the AI providers your agents, prompts, and evaluations run on.
settings.mcpEndpointsDescription: MCP servers connected to this project. Each agent chooses which of these to use and what it may run.
settings.organizationDescription: Control how members sign in and which email domains are allowed to join this organization.
settings.preferencesDescription: Personal settings stored in this browser. They are not shared with your organizations.
settings.secretsDescription: Store credentials your agents use at runtime.
settings.toolsDescription: Configure integrations your agents can use.
settings.webhooksDescription: Send workflow events to your own HTTP endpoints, with signed payloads and delivery retries.
